about: Per-flag settings for the page (docs/beta-flags.md); generation never reads this file. One object per flag:
a Z1R code ("C05") or a ZORA Extra's field name ("harder_ganon"). Its "beta" is "all" (every value but
the one a fresh page starts with) or a list of values, by the label the page shows or by number, e.g.
"C05": {"beta": ["Dungeons Only"]} or "harder_ganon": {"beta": ["Level 3"]}. A Random that can
resolve to a beta value is beta too. Remove "beta" to graduate the flag. Marking or graduating a flag
takes a one-line entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
